Done. Everything verified in the browser and in the built output.

**Env** — [astro.config.mjs](astro.config.mjs) declares a typed schema per the docs; components import from `astro:env/client`:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

`PUBLIC_SITE_URL` (drives canonical/og:url/sitemap/robots), `PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL` (the footer address — currently the `hello@example.com` placeholder), `PUBLIC_X_HANDLE` (omitted from markup when blank), `PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_URL_ENDPOINT` (optional — set it and the card is served through ImageKit at a pinned 1200×630, otherwise straight from `/og.png`).

**SEO** — title, description, canonical, `robots` with `max-image-preview:large`, Person JSON-LD, dual `theme-color`, plus generated [robots.txt](src/pages/robots.txt.ts), [sitemap.xml](src/pages/sitemap.xml.ts), and [llms.txt](src/pages/llms.txt.ts) — all built off `site`, all confirmed in `dist/`.

**Social cards** — `og:*` (Discord, Reddit, Slack, LinkedIn) + `twitter:card=summary_large_image` (X), with explicit width/height/alt. The image isn't a mockup: [scripts/og.mjs](scripts/og.mjs) serves `dist/` from a stdlib http server and screenshots the site's *own hero* with headless Chrome at 1200×630, so the card is the page. Run `pnpm og` after changing the hero.
